answer: Pay agents from a delayed vault: earnings from a new identity sit in escrow for a full epoch and are released only if no peer flags fraud. A haven for honest work, the vault turns fast fake-and-cash-out cycles into a waiting game sybils cannot win, because each clone must behave for weeks before seeing a coin. Reputation accrues as a slowly brightening opal — each honest delivery adds a facet, each dispute dims it — and buyers can filter for bright opals only. Fakes either wait out the delay, earning nothing, or expose themselves early and forfeit the escrow.
